# Project Context

Last updated: 2026-09-03 (run_id 2026-09-03) — Initial creation. No prior `context.md` existed in
`/hms/projects/m1_sdp/M1-SDP/m1-sdp-qa-pipeline` at time of writing; this document was built from
scratch by reading the codebase at `/hms/projects/m1_sdp/M1-SDP/m1-sdp` (HEAD detached at tag
`3.0.68`, latest commit `2b8c7f561`).

## Overview
- **m1-sdp** (hSenid Mobile "M1 Service Delivery Platform") is a large, long-lived telecom SDP:
  it provisions and mediates value-added services (SMS, USSD, BAS/premium billing, WAP push, MMS)
  between mobile network operator gateways (SMSC/UCP, USSD GW, SS7/Sigtran, ECGS charging) and
  content/service providers, plus back-office apps for provisioning, charging config, and CDR
  reporting.
- Multi-module Maven reactor (`pom.xml`, `groupId hsenidmobile.sdp`, `artifactId m1-sdp`,
  currently version `3.0.68`) containing ~50 modules of very mixed vintage: modern Spring Boot 3
  apps sit alongside 2008-era Ant/Ivy webapps in the same repo.
- Confirmed from `README.md`: runtime is OpenJDK 21, MySQL 8.4.4, Maven 3+; legacy modules still
  build with Ant + `HSENID_BUILD_COMMON`/`CXF_HOME` env vars, and depend on external
  hSenid-internal connector projects (`ajuba-connector`, `ussd-connector`, `spml-connector`)
  built separately from their own repos.

## Tech Stack
- **Languages/runtime:** Java 21 (`pom.xml` `maven.compiler.target=21`); a few legacy modules
  historically targeted Java 1.6 (`module.properties` in `core-logic`, `compile.target.version=1.6`,
  though the parent POM now forces 21 repo-wide).
- **Modern stack (provisioning-v2, report-viewer-v2, cdrquery):** Spring Boot 3.4.5, Spring
  6.2.6, Thymeleaf + Tailwind CSS, Spring Security OAuth2 Client (Keycloak SSO), Hibernate
  6.6.13, MySQL Connector/J 9.3.0, Log4j2 2.25.1, Jasper Reports/POI/iText (report-viewer-v2),
  Spring Data JPA (cdrquery).
- **Legacy stack (dashboard, provisioning, reportviewer, cdragent, etc.):** Ant + Ivy builds,
  JSP/Struts-style webapps, CAS-based SSO (`modules/cas`), c3p0 connection pooling, ehcache.
- **Messaging/integration middleware:** Mule ESB 3.x-style custom runtime
  (`modules/mule-integration`, packaged as `sdp-mule-integration`), RocksDB used as a local
  durable queue/burst buffer (`RocksDbBasedBurstServerEventHandler.java`, plus
  `RocksDbBurstHandler_FlowDiagram.md` at repo root documenting that flow).
- **DB:** MySQL, schema name `sdp_sla` (seen in `core-logic.properties`, `sbl-v2` README),
  accessed via JDBC/Hibernate/c3p0; `docker-compose.yaml` at root spins up `mysql:5.6.51` for
  local dev alongside newer modules that assume MySQL 8.4.4 — **version mismatch, not confirmed
  which is authoritative for current dev**.
- **Build tools present:** Maven (root `pom.xml`, `mvnw`), Ant (`build.xml` at root and in most
  legacy modules), Ivy (`ivy.xml` in legacy modules), npm/Tailwind (`package.json` in
  provisioning-v2 and report-viewer-v2 for CSS build only).
- **Auth:** Keycloak OAuth2/OIDC for the three new Spring Boot apps (see Architecture), CAS for
  legacy dashboard/provisioning/reportviewer apps.

## Architecture
- Overall style: **service-oriented monolith-of-modules** — one Maven reactor, many
  independently deployable components communicating over HTTP(S), SMPP, and Mule-mediated
  queues, sharing one MySQL database (`sdp_sla`) as the source of truth for provisioning/SLA
  data.
- Confirmed request/message flow for SMS/USSD (from `modules/sbl-v2/README.md` and
  `docs/flow-testing`):
  ```
  SP/App --> SDP (core) --http/https:7000--> SBL-V2 --http/https:9966--> USSD GW
                          <--http/https:8888--
                SBL-V2 --smpp:3001/3002--> SMPP server(s)
  ```
  SBL-V2 = SMS/USSD load-balancing gateway component in front of the USSD GW and SMPP servers,
  with its own MySQL-backed SLA data and optional one-way TLS on both the SDP↔SBL-V2 and
  SBL-V2↔MySQL links.
- `modules/mule-integration` is the core MO/MT processing engine: routes messages through SBL
  (queue names in `sbl.properties`), UCP/number-checking (`numberchecking.properties`), ECGS
  charging (`charging.properties`), and NBL (`nbl.properties`); uses RocksDB-backed queues to
  survive bursts/restarts without losing in-flight messages.
- `modules/number-checking` performs subscriber/number-type lookups against MAP GW / Sigtran GW,
  with a caching layer and per-NCS-type (SMS vs BAS vs USSD) fallback-to-cache configuration
  (see `SMS_NUMBER_CHECKING_CONFIGURATION.md`).
- Three modern Spring Boot apps sit behind a single Apache HTTPD reverse proxy and one Keycloak
  realm for SSO (confirmed in `keycloak/KEYCLOAK_SSO_GUIDE.md`):
  ```
  Browser (HTTPS :443)
        -> Apache HTTPD
             /provisioning -> https://localhost:8082/provisioning  (provisioning-v2)
             /report       -> https://localhost:8084/report        (report-viewer-v2)
             /cdrquery     -> https://localhost:8088/cdrquery      (cdrquery)
             /             -> https://localhost:9443/              (Keycloak)
  ```
- `HAMultiHost_Flow_Diagram.md` documents a generic high-availability multi-host client
  (parses a comma-separated URL list, health-checks hosts, fails over) used for outbound
  connector calls — check which connectors use it before assuming any single one does; not
  independently confirmed which callers use `HAMultiHost` beyond the diagram doc.

## Modules / Components
- **provisioning-v2** — Spring Boot 3 web app (Thymeleaf) for SP/application/CR provisioning
  and SLA management; Keycloak OAuth2 client, HTTPS on `:8082`, context path `/provisioning`.
  Path: `modules/provisioning-v2`
- **provisioning** (legacy) — original Ant/JSP provisioning webapp, CAS-secured, being
  superseded by provisioning-v2. Path: `modules/provisioning`
- **provisioning-startup-services** — shared startup/init services consumed by
  provisioning(-v2). Path: `modules/provisioning-startup-services`
- **dashboard** — legacy Ant/JSP operational dashboard (Flash-based charts under `flash_src/`),
  CAS-secured. Path: `modules/dashboard`
- **sbl-v2** — SMS/USSD load-balancing gateway in front of USSD GW/SMPP servers; Spring-based,
  MySQL-backed, optional mutual TLS. Path: `modules/sbl-v2`
- **mule-integration** — Mule-based core MO/MT message processing engine; RocksDB-backed burst
  queue; integrates SBL, number-checking/UCP, ECGS charging, NBL. Path: `modules/mule-integration`
- **number-checking** — subscriber number-type lookup/caching against MAP GW / Sigtran GW, with
  per-NCS-type (SMS/BAS/USSD) config. Path: `modules/number-checking`
- **charging** — charging/ECGS integration logic and its own DB setup scripts. Path:
  `modules/charging`

# Changes — 3.0.65 → 3.0.68

Source: git log/diff, tag range `3.0.65..3.0.68` in `/hms/projects/m1_sdp/M1-SDP/m1-sdp` (25
non-merge commits, spanning intermediate releases 3.0.66 and 3.0.67).
Analyzed: 2026-09-04

## Summary
- Breaking Changes: 0
- New Features: 2
- Enhancements: 4
- Bug Fixes: 8
- Refactors / Internal: 4
- Config / Infra: 7
- Unclear / Needs Clarification: 0

(25 commits total; `[maven-release-plugin] prepare release/for next development iteration`
version-bump commits and one revert-of-a-revert are folded into the Config/Infra entries they
relate to rather than counted separately.)

## New Features
- **Pagination on SP application search** — Added pagination to the service-provider application
  search/listing flow; backing repository methods (`AppRepositoryImpl`,
  `SpRepositoryImpl`) and the `ApplicationListBySpUserService`/`BaseProvisioningService` were
  restructured to support it, replacing the old `AppListService`. Affected: `provisioning-v2`
  (`modules/provisioning-v2`), `core-logic` repositories. Ref: `46600a3d1`
- **USSD-connector TLS hostname verification & protocol configuration** — Added configuration
  support (`ussd-connector.ssl.hostname-verification-enabled`,
  `ussd-connector.ssl.enabled-protocols`) so SBL-v2's USSD connector client can enforce hostname
  verification and pin allowed TLS versions (defaults to `TLSv1.3,TLSv1.2`); bumped
  `ussd-connector` dependency 1.0.86 → 1.0.89. Affected: `sbl-v2`
  (`modules/sbl-v2/src/main/java/com/hms/sbl/v2/configuration/Configuration.java`,
  `application.yaml`), `pom.xml`. Ref: `ecf8d972f`, `10e010bf9`

## Enhancements
- **Bulk-fetch CSV export data** — Reworked CSV download data retrieval to bulk-fetch records
  instead of issuing per-application queries, reducing DB round-trips for provisioning CSV
  exports. Affected: `provisioning-v2` (`CsvDownLoadMangerServiceImpl`, `DataRetriverDao(Impl)`,
  `DataRetriverService(Impl)`, `ProvisioningQueries`). Ref: `f0fd261ee`
- **Loading indicators on report view/download** — Added a shared loading-indicator fragment and
  wired it into the "view"/"download" buttons across all report-viewer-v2 daily/weekly/monthly/
  yearly report pages, plus a related messages.properties entry and footer include. Affected:
  `reporting/report-viewer-v2` (Thymeleaf templates + `loading.html` fragment). Ref: `10e722904`,
  `a0f4927ca` (follow-up loading-related fixes)
- **Global exception handling for report-viewer-v2** — Added `GlobalExceptionHandler` and
  `ReportErrorMessages`, and extended `CustomErrorController`, to centralize error responses
  instead of ad-hoc per-controller handling. Affected: `reporting/report-viewer-v2`
  (`v2/controller/*`). Ref: `ce807dfda`
- **Refactored DB-down error handling across report controllers** — Consolidated duplicated
  DB-connectivity error-handling logic out of ~19 individual report controllers
  (daily/hourly/monthly/weekly/yearly) into shared handling via `DatabaseConfig`. Affected:
  `reporting/report-viewer-v2` / `reporting/datatransfer_v2` (`DatabaseConfig.java`, report
  controllers). Ref: `917aa5c3e`

## Bug Fixes
- **SMS-MO translog falsely showed SUCCESS on SSL hostname verification failure** — `SdpMessageSender`
  now rethrows the exception on send failure instead of swallowing it, so SMS-MO failures are
  logged/reported consistently with USSD-MO. Affected: `sbl-v2`
  (`services/processor/impl/smpp/SdpMessageSender.java`). Ref: `6bfaaba1f`
- **Fix NPEs on draft and CR charging SLA edits** — Added missing `getId()` getters on
  `FlatChargeServiceType`/`FreeChargeServiceType`, reordered MT-charging-SLA initialization ahead
  of validation in draft SMS/USSD edit flows, and reordered `handleChargingSlaChange`/
  `setUpdatedNcsCharingSla` calls in the CR draft-reject flow to run before validation/update.
  Affected: `core-logic` (charging SLA domain), `provisioning-v2`
  (`ListDraftAppReqController`, `CrDraftRejectController`, `ApplicationRequestService`). Ref:
  `42ef3d8c1`
- **Fix stale USSD service code registration on CR activation** — Passes the pre-swap service
  code as `oldServiceCode`, stops form binding from overwriting the production `additionalInfo`
  map, and publishes the state change only after commit. Affected: `provisioning-v2`
  (`BaseProvisioningService`, `CrApprovedAppReqService`, `CrApprovedProductionService`,
  `CrPreActiveProductionService`; adds `BaseProvisioningServiceTest`,
  `ProdSlaModificationServiceTest`). Ref: `bdfbf5554`
- **Report title/column-header fixes** — Corrected a report-title mismatch (`cf3211d07`,
  Application Revenue Summary / Revenue TopUp Summary monthly jrxml), a separate title
  correction (`cb6cd966b`, Application Traffic Summary Month jrxml), and a column-header
  cut-off issue (`ec1b04097`, Detailed Application Traffic Report Month/Year jrxml). Affected:
  `reporting/report-viewer-v2` (Jasper `.jrxml` report definitions). Ref: `cb6cd966b`,
  `cf3211d07`, `ec1b04097`
- **Application traffic summary HTML layout overflow** — Fixed overlapping JRXML column
  coordinates for Application ID/Application Name and added HTML-only wrapping styles so long
  application names stay within their Jasper report cells; adjusted
  `ApplicationTrafficSummaryJasperReportService`. Affected: `reporting/report-viewer-v2`. Ref:
  `28e471aed`
- **Loading-indicator/error-state fixes** — Follow-up fixes to the newly added loading indicator
  across 12+ daily/hourly/monthly report pages (`loading.html` fragment usage corrections).
  Affected: `reporting/report-viewer-v2`. Ref: `a0f4927ca`
- **SNMP trap on DB-connection shutdown removed** — Removed SNMP trap triggering that fired
  during DB connection shutdown (spurious alert on normal app shutdown), adding
  `ApplicationShutdownState` to distinguish shutdown-triggered disconnects from real failures;
  added `ConnectionListenerShutdownTest`/`GlobalExceptionHandlerTest`. Affected:
  `reporting/report-viewer-v2` (`v2/config/ApplicationShutdownState.java`,
  `ConnectionListener.java`, `DbConnectionHealthScheduler.java`). Ref: `cc8ce3cef`

## Refactors / Internal
- **Revert of a revert: restore ussd-connector SSL hostname-verification/protocol properties** —
  `10e010bf9` reverts an earlier commit (`2b79211df`, not in this release range) that had removed
  these "dead" properties; they turned out to be needed and were restored as the base for the
  new feature above. Affected: `sbl-v2` (`Configuration.java`, `application.yaml`). Ref:
  `10e010bf9`
- Version-bump-only "prepare for next development iteration" / "prepare release" commits for
  3.0.66, 3.0.67, 3.0.68 (no functional change). Ref: `1263991ac`, `05d07736c`, `bef5df3da`,
  `32d3d7393`, `6ad24e4de`, `2b8c7f561`
- **Removed stale 3.0.67 release-note commit** — Deleted `RELEASE_NOTE_3.0.67.md` after it was
  added by mistake in the previous release-prep commit. Affected: `modules/reporting/report-viewer-v2`.
  Ref: `8946603b0`

## Config / Infra
- **Deduplicated `ehcache` / `hms-common-util` jars in SDP core and traffic-updater** — Excluded
  `net.sf.ehcache:ehcache` from `mule-integration`'s dependency tree and corrected the
  `hms-common-util` groupId (`hms.common` → `hms`) + bumped it 1.0.11 → 1.0.14 in
  `traffic-updater`, plus excluded `ehcache` from its `traffic-notification-client` dependency.
  Affected: `mule-integration`, `traffic-controller/traffic-updater` (`pom.xml`). Ref: `c57f0b16`
- **Deduplicated jars in report-viewer-v2 (round 1)** — Excluded `net.sf.ehcache:ehcache` and
  `net.sf.jsr107cache:jsr107cache` from `sdp-core-logic`/`sdp-web-core` deps (superseded by
  `org.ehcache:ehcache:3.10.8`), and excluded duplicate `bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk14`/
  `bcmail-jdk14` (1.38) pulled in transitively via `itext`. Affected:
  `reporting/report-viewer-v2` (`pom.xml`). Ref: `41bab91ab`
- **Excluded duplicate BouncyCastle jars and unused `spring-security-cas`, version bump to
  3.0.67-SNAPSHOT** — Removed `spring-security-cas` (and its transitive `cas-client-core`/
  `bcprov`/`bcpkix`/`bcutil-jdk15on`) from `sdp-web-core` since CAS auth is no longer used in
  report-viewer-v2, plus further BouncyCastle exclusions from `itext`; touched 15 other module
  `pom.xml` files (dependency-version alignment) and added `RELEASE_NOTE_3.0.67.md` (later
  removed, see Refactors/Internal). Affected: `reporting/report-viewer-v2` and 14 other modules
  (`core-logic`, `charging`, `component-integration`, `hms-common-ncs-message`, `http-ha`,
  `mule-integration`, `number-checking`, `performance`, `provisioning-startup-services`,
  `provisioning-v2`, `reporting/cdrquery`, `reporting/dataloader_v2`, `reporting/datarecover_v2`,
  `reporting/datatransfer_v2`, `sbl-v2`, `snmp`, `traffic-notification-client`,
  `traffic-controller/traffic-updater`). Ref: `e18e3a8b7`
- **`ussd-connector` dependency bump 1.0.86 → 1.0.89** — Root `pom.xml` version property update,
  paired with the new SSL config support above. Affected: `sbl-v2` / root `pom.xml`. Ref:
  `ecf8d972f`
- **Full module version bump across the reactor to 3.0.68 (from 3.0.65 baseline)** — `ws/sms`,
  `ws/ussd`, `ws/premium-service` skeleton/stub `pom.xml` files and ~120 other module poms bumped
  in lockstep with the three intermediate release-prepare commits (126 files, 3251(+)/1942(-)
  across the full `3.0.65..3.0.68` diff — largely version-string churn, not independently
  reviewed line-by-line beyond the itemized commits above). Ref: full range diff
  `3.0.65..3.0.68`

## Unclear / Needs Clarification
None — all 25 commits in range had commit messages specific enough to categorize. Note that two
commits (`cb6cd966b` "title correction" and `cf3211d07` "fixed report title difference") have
terse messages; categorization above is based on reading their `.jrxml` diffs directly, not on
message content alone.

  verification and pin allowed TLS versions (defaults to `TLSv1.3,TLSv1.2`); bumped

  yearly report pages, plus a related messages.properties entry and footer include. Affected:
  `reporting/report-viewer-v2` (Thymeleaf templates + `loading.html` fragment). Ref: `10e722904`,
  `a0f4927ca` (follow-up loading-related fixes)

  `ReportErrorMessages`, and extended `CustomErrorController`, to centralize error responses
  instead of ad-hoc per-controller handling. Affected: `reporting/report-viewer-v2`
  (`v2/controller/*`). Ref: `ce807dfda`

  DB-connectivity error-handling logic out of ~19 individual report controllers

  logged/reported consistently with USSD-MO. Affected: `sbl-v2`

  code as `oldServiceCode`, stops form binding from overwriting the production `additionalInfo`

  (`BaseProvisioningService`, `CrApprovedAppReqService`, `CrApprovedProductionService`,
  `CrPreActiveProductionService`; adds `BaseProvisioningServiceTest`,
  `ProdSlaModificationServiceTest`). Ref: `bdfbf5554`

  correction (`cb6cd966b`, Application Traffic Summary Month jrxml), and a column-header
  cut-off issue (`ec1b04097`, Detailed Application Traffic Report Month/Year jrxml). Affected:

  `cf3211d07`, `ec1b04097`
- **Application traffic summary HTML layout overflow** — Fixed overlapping JRXML column
  coordinates for Application ID/Application Name and added HTML-only wrapping styles so long
  application names stay within their Jasper report cells; adjusted
  `ApplicationTrafficSummaryJasperReportService`. Affected: `reporting/report-viewer-v2`. Ref:
  `28e471aed`

  across 12+ daily/hourly/monthly report pages (`loading.html` fragment usage corrections).
  Affected: `reporting/report-viewer-v2`. Ref: `a0f4927ca`

  during DB connection shutdown (spurious alert on normal app shutdown), adding
  `ApplicationShutdownState` to distinguish shutdown-triggered disconnects from real failures;
  added `ConnectionListenerShutdownTest`/`GlobalExceptionHandlerTest`. Affected:
  `reporting/report-viewer-v2` (`v2/config/ApplicationShutdownState.java`,
  `ConnectionListener.java`, `DbConnectionHealthScheduler.java`). Ref: `cc8ce3cef`

- **`ussd-connector` dependency bump 1.0.86 → 1.0.89** — Root `pom.xml` version property update,
